messages:
Anna G: quick heads-up — pulling the weekly cohort heatmap for launch posts + webinar funnel. noticed an onboarding MQL spike for the cohort tied to webinar-01 between 2024-03-14 and 2024-03-18. can someone double-check attribution? :eyes:

Leo A: looking now. initial glance -> session count up ~42% but paid clicks are flat. that smells like an attribution/sample artefact rather than real lift. link to heatmap: https://dash.redwood.com/r/launch-cohort :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sara P: heads-up i rolled a config change for the tracking pixel sample rate on 2024-03-15 (5% -> 50%) to diagnose ingestion during the spike window. might be inflating sessions. pinging @David M to confirm the change and whether we reverted.

David M: confirmed — we bumped sample_rate for a short test on 2024-03-15 and reverted same day. ingestion pipeline used sampled counts for streaming dashboards, which explains the transient bump. will need normalized metrics for accurate week-over-week.

Anna G: ok — two asks: 1) analytics to add a sample-normalized series + annotate the spike on the public KPI board; 2) ops to re-run lead-routing/matchback for 2024-03-14 -> 2024-03-20 so MQL counts reflect reconciled leads.

Leo A: will add normalized series and an annotation. adding a quick SQL stub for normalization so eng can vet:
```sql
SELECT event_date, SUM(count_distinct_user_id) * (1/NULLIF(approx_sample_rate,1)) AS adjusted_sessions
FROM events_by_day
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2024-03-10' AND '2024-03-25'
GROUP BY event_date;
```

David M: queued a rerun of the matchback job — ETA ~2h. command I used: `airflow trigger_dag matchback_launch_posts --conf '{"start":"2024-03-14","end":"2024-03-20"}'`. will post when complete.

Julia R: also want to flag messaging confounders — the webinar follow-up had an alternate subject line (subject-B) that performed ~3x better during that same window. need to separate traffic influenced by messaging from attribution/sample issues.

Sara P: noted — I'll attach the campaign subject variants and the send times to the deck so analytics can segment.

dashbot: dashboard updated — added "adjusted_sessions" series and annotation for sample-rate experiment on 2024-03-15. public board: https://dash.redwood.com/r/launch-cohort (annotation id: a-20240315-sample)

Anna G: great work — once matchback finishes can we re-run the weekly KPI snapshot and share a short note to #marketing? want to avoid noisy VOC in the executive digest. :thumbsup:
